Sunburst (radial hierarchy) diagram

Source: R/sunburst.R
vsunburst.Rd

vsunburst() draws a tree as concentric rings of sectors: depth maps to a ring and each node's angular span is its share of its parent's. Input is a parent list — id, parent (NA at the root), and value (leaf values; an internal node's value is the sum of its children). Like vgraph() / vsankey() it returns a ready, axis-free, aspect-locked PlotSpec; mark_sunburst() is the layer it adds.

Usage

vsunburst(
  data,
  id,
  parent,
  value,
  inner_radius = 0,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 96,
  inner.radius = NULL
)

mark_sunburst(plot, id, parent, value, inner_radius = 0, inner.radius = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame describing a hierarchy (a parent list).

id, parent, value

Columns (tidy-eval): the node id, its parent id (NA/"" for the root), and its value (used for leaves).

inner_radius

Central hole radius, a fraction in [0, 1); 0 (default) fills to the centre.

width, height, dpi

Page size (inches) and resolution.

inner.radius

Deprecated; renamed to inner_radius.

plot

A PlotSpec.

Value

A PlotSpec (vsunburst()) or the modified plot (mark_sunburst()).

Details

The root is the centre (not drawn as a wedge); inner_radius opens a hole. Nodes are coloured by depth. The input must be a single-rooted tree.

Examples

h <- data.frame(
  id = c("root", "A", "B", "A1", "A2", "B1"),
  parent = c(NA, "root", "root", "A", "A", "B"),
  value = c(NA, NA, NA, 3, 2, 4)
)
vsunburst(h, id, parent, value)
